target_and_admission.original_P0_target_ret: r[j]=r[t+1], a single endpoint-to-endpoint increment, not r[k+1]+r[k+2]
target_and_admission.calendar_and_provider_limit: Existing union-calendar/ffill target remains a constructed retrospective target. Lag1 is not a historical clock-availability certificate.

exact_distributional_derivation.parameters: ZeroMean, GARCH/GJR(1,1),power2,StudentsT,rescaleFalse; parameter estimates treated as fixed conditional plug-in values, no parameter uncertainty integration
exact_distributional_derivation.h1: h[k+1|F_k] in percentage-return squared, passed from a valid fit/filter using ONLY returns through k
exact_distributional_derivation.dependence: Z1,Z2 independent innovations; R1,R2 not independent because h2 depends onR1. Replacing h2 by its expected2step variance loses the joint predictive law.
exact_distributional_derivation.stable_implementation: Equivalent centered/Welford update: SSE20=SSE18+(18/19)*(R1-c18)^2+(19/20)*(R2-c19)^2;V20=SSE20/19. Avoids cancellation nearconstant windows.
exact_distributional_derivation.population_monotone_property: Population median of sqrt(252V) is sqrt(252*median(V)). Finite interpolated sample medians need not commute; the chosen inverted_cdf order statistic does.

one_dimensional_CDF_identity.reference_solver: Synthetic only: scipy.integrate.quad over the finite admissibleR1 interval, split at0; brentq root ofF_V(m²/252)=.5.

shape_and_parameter_checks.local_arch8_static_bounds: alpha,beta in[0,1]; gamma in[-1,2] forp=o=1;nu in[2.05,500]
shape_and_parameter_checks.nu_math_vs_fit: nu>2 mathematically defines finite unit variance; actual localarch8fitting bounds are stricter[2.05,500]
shape_and_parameter_checks.omega_fit_bounds: [1e-8*v,10*v],v=mean(abs(fit_residuals)^power); requires full fitted history and is not verified by this bridge
shape_and_parameter_checks.h1_validity: positive finite in production; h1=omega=0 permitted only in labelled synthetic boundary test
shape_and_parameter_checks.complete_arch_feasibility: A future fitting adapter must retain exact data-dependent arch feasibility checks from original08C-R; this helper checks only stated scalar/static conditions.
shape_and_parameter_checks.negative_gamma: Allowed when alpha+gamma>=0 and other constraints hold; validated withgamma=-0.10.

primary_predeclared_guard.interpretation: Provisional numerical stability/error-estimate guard selected before any marketfits/testmetrics; not rigorous interval-arithmetic population-median certification.

numerical_policy.MC_role: Independent synthetic diagnostic only; theCRNpoint is not the primary P1benchmark prediction
numerical_policy.algorithm: PCG64fixed-seed common uniforms(N,2), inverseStudentT CDF withunitvariance scale, pathwise2step recursion, exactVol20 formula, pooled empirical median
numerical_policy.training_seeds_are_different: 123/777/2026 belong to model training; not used as an implicit MC tolerance choice
numerical_policy.common_random_numbers: Within each replication, allNlevels use prefixes of the same stream; same streams can be reused acrossGARCH/GJR specification at a given experiment. Explicit stream keys must be retained in any future adapter.
numerical_policy.quantile_method: numpy.quantile(q=.5,method=inverted_cdf): lower empirical median, a valid finite-sample MAE/pinball0.5 minimizer
numerical_policy.acceptance: At the maximum grid: each of the last2successive pooled-quantile changes<=max(atol,rtol*abs(point)), and every replication median deviates from pooledpoint by<=that tolerance.
numerical_policy.failure: NUMERICAL_UNRESOLVED withpoint=None; diagnostics retained, no persistence fallback. No observed stable result means no eligible benchmark prediction.
numerical_policy.hard_budget_limit: A fixed finiteN and passing replication/prefix diagnostics DO NOT prove a uniform or exact population-quantile error bound. Synthetic reference agreement applies only to the tested parameters; future fit cases need the same guards and may remain unresolved.
numerical_policy.pinball_error_propagation: For tau=.5, |rho(y-mhat)-rho(y-m)|<=.5*|mhat-m|. If an actual quantile error boundepsilon were established, mean pinball error is bounded by.5*mean(epsilon); a ratio error is additionally divided by that asset baseline denominator. Observed replication stability alone is not such a bound.
numerical_policy.before_market_freeze_gate: PrimaryCDF/root tolerances and stricter-repeat guards are explicitly predeclared here, independently of markettestmetrics. MC tolerances remain SYNTHETIC diagnostic settings and do not select/replace the primaryCDFpoint. No exact universal quantileerror certificate is supplied; passing3cases does not certify allfits and any future failedguard remains unresolved.
numerical_policy.identity_tolerance: Vol20 formula vsbrute-array std maxabs<2e-14; percent/decimal recursion maxabs<2e-18
numerical_policy.negative_variance_handling: Values below-1e-14 fail; tiny negative roundoff in[-1e-14,0) may be set tozero only; never repair substantive invalid paths.

future_fit_pipeline_NOT_EXECUTED: Take root-approved P1date/mask contract. Resolve latest admitted k=t-1 and targetj=k+2 by exact ordered indices; assert known18end==k and no later row is read.

Fit expanding univariate admitted returns throughk only;meanZero,p1,q1,o0or1,power2,StudentsT,rescaleFalse,percentage units. Preserve inherited validation-independent retry/start policy before execution; this file authorizes no fit.

Accept fitted parameters/h1only after convergence, finite outputs, exactarch constraints/data-dependent bounds andnu checks. Invalidfit=>explicit missing status; no parameter/model/persistence fallback.

For each validfit, integrate the joint two-increment conditionalCDF and solve itsVol20median through median_cdf_or_missing, including the stricter-repeat guard. CRNpath quantiles are independent diagnostics only. Reject unresolved bridges instead of publishing the last diagnostic quantile.

Scoring masks select metric rows but do not silently compress the fitted calendar or change return windows. Any such history deletion is a separate data/model protocol requiring a newly derived horizon.

Compare on identical targetdates and scoring masks, retain complete-pair coverage and numerical failures. Use the targetmedian forpinball0.5; directdailyconditional sigma remains a different diagnostic target.
Before any execution, root must pin numericalbudget/tolerance and exception policy without testperformance tuning; test observed errors must not determineMCbudget, models or retries.
